roles.esp32: Runs the sketch and drives the I2C bus
roles.velxio-ssd1306-i2c-4pin: Shows Hello Velxio and a live counter

igCaption: A 4-pin SSD1306 OLED wired to an ESP32 over I2C. The sketch prints Hello Velxio and a counter that ticks up every half second. Four wires, no extra parts, and the screen does the talking.
ytTitle: ESP32 SSD1306 OLED counter in the browser #shorts
ytDescription: An ESP32 drives a 4-pin SSD1306 OLED over I2C and prints a counter that updates every 500 ms. The whole circuit runs in Velxio, a free browser simulator. Open it in your browser: https://velxio.dev/example/esp32-oled-4pin-i2c
